LanguageData.Make_GreenTea.label: Dry green tea
LanguageData.Make_GreenTea.description: Green tea is a drink made from the leaves of the tea camellia. Actually, like black tea. Their main difference is that for green tea the fermentation process is minimal, which makes it closer to a living tea leaf. And the more the tea is fermented, the darker its infusion and the brighter its taste.
